programme: NFATC2, STAT4 and IRF4 form a T-lymphocyte antigen-receptor/cytokine-transcription circuit: NFATC2 (calcineurin-NFAT, activated by TCR/CD3-driven calcium flux) and STAT4 (downstream of IL-12 receptor signaling) and IRF4 (downstream of TCR/costimulation) converge on overlapping cytokine loci in their target lists — TNF and IL21 shared between STAT4 and NFATC2, IL4 shared between IRF4 and NFATC2, IFNG driven by STAT4 with IRF4 acting on IL17A/IRF5/PRDM1 — the canonical composite-element logic that sets Th1/Th17/Tfh-type effector cytokine output.
role_in_a: In cardiovascular disease this circuit is the transcriptional engine of Th1/Th17-skewed T-cell activation that drives IFN-γ, IL-17A, TNF and IL-2 production implicated in vascular/atherosclerotic inflammation, and its transcripts are used as circulating-leukocyte activity markers.
role_in_b: In Huntington's disease, peripheral immune activation in blood has been reported as a systemic feature of the illness, and NFATC2 specifically has a documented disease-relevant role in HD striatal astrocytes via non-canonical WNT5B signaling and extracellular-matrix remodeling — evidence that NFATC2-linked signaling is disease-relevant in HD, though through a different cell type than the T-cell circuit proposed here.
shared_axis: If NFATC2/STAT4/IRF4 activity in blood reflects a generalized, chronic low-grade T-cell/cytokine activation tone, that same circulating inflammatory state could independently feed vascular inflammation in CVD and contribute to or read out the systemic immune activation reported in HD, without either disease being the cause of the other.
reasoning: The three carrying factors form a genuine, nameable co-regulatory module (overlapping cytokine-gene targets, well-characterized TCR/calcium and cytokine-receptor signaling logic), and HD placement is corroborated by Open Targets (NFATC2 0.93, IRF4 0.72; STAT4 only 0.33) plus one retrieved paper for NFATC2. But Open Targets shows no association at all for any of the 12 factors in cardiovascular disease, and the one HD paper describes an astrocytic ECM mechanism rather than a T-cell/cytokine one, so the CVD-HD link rests on immunology reasoning rather than anything jointly retrieved — pulling this below 'supported' into 'unexpected', with only moderate strength.
support: PMID 41549079 — reports NFATC2 in HD striatal astrocytes via noncanonical WNT5B signaling driving extracellular-matrix remodeling and neuropathology; this is the only disease-relevant hit in the record, and it supports NFATC2's involvement in HD generally but not the T-cell cytokine mechanism proposed here specifically.
how_to_falsify: Stimulate PBMCs (or purified CD4+ T cells) from matched CVD and HD cohorts through the TCR/CD3-CD28 pathway, measure NFATC2/STAT4/IRF4 occupancy (CUT&RUN or ChIP) at IFNG, IL4, IL17A, TNF and IL21, and measure the corresponding cytokine output; if activation-induced binding and cytokine transcription at these loci are not concordantly shifted relative to matched controls in both diseases, the shared T-cell cytokine axis account is falsified.
caveats: Both diseases sampled from blood, which favors a shared circuit being immune rather than tissue-specific, but the 168 patient-group comparisons come from only 4 independent cohort pairs, so apparent robustness is inflated by within-cohort subgroup repetition. Several classic hematopoietic/immune master regulators (CEBPB, BCL6, SPIB, FOXO1, PRDM1, NFATC1, IRF8, GFI1) were removed as tissue-generic before ranking, so the immune story here is carried by three second-tier, more specific factors rather than the dominant blood-immune regulators — that is the reason the 'obvious' immune master regulators are absent, not an oversight. The other 9 concordant factors (GRHL2, PHF20, BRCA1, SSRP1, MAFK, ZNF335, AEBP1, SALL1, KLF7) span epithelial, chromatin/FACT, oxidative-stress, lipid-handling, DNA-repair and neurodevelopmental biology and do not fit this or any single coherent module with the T-cell circuit, and are deliberately excluded from the programme rather than forced into it. The single-view exclusions (THAP9, TRRAP, PIAS4, etc.) are unrelated chromatin/zinc-finger factors idiosyncratic to individual subgroups and do not bear on this account.
